meme_list:
📋 **Meme Category & Help List**:
Type the command with format: `meme <category>`

• `meme dank` (Dank memes)
• `meme meirl` (Relatable memes)
• `meme wholesome` (Wholesome memes)
• `meme programmer` (IT/Coding memes)
• `meme anime` (Anime memes)
• `meme cats` (Cat memes)
• `meme gaming` (Gaming memes)
• `meme history` (History memes)
• `meme science` (Science memes)
• `meme tech` (Technology memes)
• `meme bug` / `error` (Software error memes)
• `meme comics` (Funny comics)
• `meme random` (Random memes)

💡 **Usage Examples:**
• `meme programmer`
• `meme gaming`
• `meme random`
